draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Angamaly! This town was once the seat of Mar Abraham, the last East Syriac bishop to reach the Malabar Coast, and its old churches go back to the 1500s.
draft.hungryLine: Angamaly is a busy junction town, so you'll find simple Kerala meals and tea shops all around the centre.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Three historic churches are within an 8 minute walk: Mar Hormizd Cathedral, St. Mary's Cheriyapally and St. George Basilica.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Step into the quiet of Mar Hormizd Cathedral, just 4 minutes away, and look around a church built in 1578.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Old coins and other finds show this area was mostly Buddhist and Jain long before its famous churches.

spots.name: Mar Hormizd Syro-Malabar Cathedral, Angamaly
spots.detail: 4 min walk · Built in 1578 by Mar Abraham

spots.name: St. Mary's Jacobite Soonoro Cathedral, Angamaly
spots.detail: 8 min walk · Founded in 1564, known locally as Cheriyapally

spots.name: St. George Syro-Malabar Basilica, Angamaly
spots.detail: 8 min walk · Made a minor basilica in 2009

legends.title: The Apostle's visit
legends.body: Tradition says Thomas the Apostle came to this region from the port of Kodungaloor in AD 52. Angamaly grew into a centre of Saint Thomas Christians.

tips.title: Keep an umbrella handy.
tips.body: Kerala gets rain for at least seven to eight months a year.

tips.title: Use the station for the airport.
tips.body: Angamaly railway station is the closest one to Cochin International Airport, about 5 km away.

story.title: Buddhist and Jain roots
story.body: Old coins and other artifacts show the region was mostly Buddhist and Jain. Churches followed, with evidence of some built as early as AD 409 and AD 822.

story.title: A bishop's seat
story.body: Cheriyapally was founded in 1564. Mar Abraham, once imprisoned by the Portuguese in Goa, made Angamaly his see and built Mar Hormizd Cathedral in 1578.

story.title: The archdeacon's home
story.body: Archdeacon Thomas Parambil lived at Cheriyapally. After the Coonan Cross Oath in 1653 he was consecrated as bishop Mar Thoma I.

story.title: The police firing
story.body: On 13 June 1959 police fired on protesters demonstrating against Kerala's communist government. The event is still tied to the town's name.

story.title: A Kochi gateway
story.body: Angamaly became a municipality in 1978 and is now part of the Kochi metropolitan area. In 2009 Pope Benedict XVI made St George's a minor basilica.
